verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩ : ਗਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੁੱਧ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 13 : gaa(n) dhe dhu'dh dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਈ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਧੁ ਉਜਲੁ ਵਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gaiee ra(n)g bira(n)g bahu dhudh ujal varanaa|

en.bdb: Cows are of different hues but the milk of all is white.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਧਹੁ ਦਹੀ ਜਮਾਈਐ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਧਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhudhahu dhahee jamaieeaai kar nihachal dharanaa|

en.bdb: For making curd Some rennet is added into it and then it is placed undistributed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਹੀ ਵਿਲੋਇ ਅਲੋਈਐ ਛਾਹਿ ਮਖਣ ਤਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhahee viloi aloieeaai chhaeh makhan taranaa|

en.bdb: By churning curd one finds butter over the butter milk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਖਣੁ ਤਾਇ ਅਉਟਾਇ ਕੈ ਘਿਉ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: makhan tai aauTai kai ghiau niramal karanaa|

en.bdb: The butter boiled properly is transformed into ghee – clarified butter.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਨਈਵੇਦ ਕਰਿ ਸਭ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਰਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: hom jag nieevedh kar sabh kaaraj saranaa|

en.bdb: Then that ghee is used as burnt offering and him yajn(rituals) and other oblation are performed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਜਰਣਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit_en: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh hoi jaranaa ||13||

en.bdb: Gurmukh knows that the Lord is all pervading but to reach Him one has to have  spiritual quest as well as the sense of contentment.
